phase_boundary.promote_semantics: admission only to the named V-test; never implementation, trajectory, endpoint, D-071, gate, science, or public authority

deduplication.method: Read the cited evidence and candidate-specific content directly; did not count copied or shared evidence_fingerprint strings as corroboration.
deduplication.result: No substantive conflict required a rerun. Phase-5 and Phase-6 labels agree after separating factual support, mathematical testability, and Phase-8 experiment admission.

candidate_decisions.promotion_scope: mandatory null/control and evidence-identity test only; not a remedy candidate

assessment.evidence: STRONG for instrument noncompletion, absent scientific predicate, and unmeasured creep mechanism; none for a positive remedy.
assessment.physical_validity: VALID as an epistemic control because it makes no physical falsification claim.
assessment.mathematical_validity: VALID as a falsifiable null; it must not be strengthened to a universal impossibility theorem.
assessment.novelty: LOW, deliberately; value is attribution discipline.
assessment.testability: HIGH through exact identity, raw-state, terminal-cause, and complete work accounting.
assessment.robustness: HIGH if all work buckets and raw failure states are mandatory.
assessment.tractability: HIGH; V0 is a bounded evidence contract.
assessment.residual_uncertainty: HIGH about the actual creep mechanism; V0 cannot reconstruct missing historical solver state.

candidate_decisions.rationale: Every later candidate needs V0 to distinguish mechanism movement from stale bytes, changed cases, or omitted counters.
candidate_decisions.dissent: H0 is not a remedy and could be held outside the survivor set; promotion is retained only because V0 is the common control required to interpret any survivor.
candidate_decisions.unresolved_risk: A future case can still be under-instrumented and remain ambiguous.
candidate_decisions.next_phase: Phase 9 may formalize only the V0 identity/work-evidence contract; no production code or new gate.

assessment.evidence: MODERATE-STRONG for strict-open Rust decoding and known false-success classes; incomplete for all callers.
assessment.physical_validity: CONDITIONAL: interior logit/log maps are physical, but boundary saturation and channel-valid invariant scope must remain explicit.
assessment.mathematical_validity: SOUND on open domains; derivatives become singular as f approaches 0 or 1 or X approaches 0.
assessment.novelty: MODEST; the useful contribution is the explicit separation of physical admission from software terminal precedence.
assessment.testability: HIGH with the frozen mutant/good-control table and a software-only comparator.
assessment.robustness: MODERATE-HIGH if raw failing and last-accepted states remain distinct and no projection is allowed.
assessment.tractability: HIGH; existing outcome/admission surfaces suffice before any refactor.
assessment.assumption_burden: MODERATE, chiefly physical error scales and representability margins.
assessment.residual_uncertainty: Cross-stack caller coverage and extreme-tail representability.

candidate_decisions.rationale: V1 is cheap, directly falsifiable, and can show whether the physics layer adds discrimination beyond typed software outcomes without making a performance claim.
candidate_decisions.dissent: A software-only typed outcome may kill the complete table, in which case H1 adds no value and is killed by its own criterion.
candidate_decisions.unresolved_risk: Bad scale allocation could reject a valid but poorly represented tail state.
candidate_decisions.next_phase: Phase 9 may formalize the existing-function V1 table and error scales only.

assessment.evidence: MODERATE for flat-FLRW EOS and signs; ABSENT for the required full-branch state envelope, EOS inverse certificate, and positive alpha margin.
assessment.physical_validity: CONDITIONAL and limited to flat FLRW; only rho_em may replace T_gamma while rho_nu remains derived from f.
assessment.mathematical_validity: LOCAL inversion follows from positive heat capacity, but global one-to-one inversion and dN/dx regularity are unproved.
assessment.novelty: MODERATE-LOW; a standard coordinate idea whose nonredundant formulation is useful.
assessment.testability: MEDIUM only after the completing, transfer-extremum, stalled, cold, and boundary states are prospectively bound.
assessment.robustness: LOW-MODERATE until numerical error is smaller than the alpha margin.
assessment.tractability: MEDIUM as read-only EOS work, but current retained D-071 evidence lacks the stalled state dump.
assessment.assumption_burden: HIGH for a full-branch transversality claim.
assessment.residual_uncertainty: Whether the necessary state envelope exists without a forbidden new trajectory, and whether the coordinate beats analytic T-in-N by 10x.

candidate_decisions.rationale: Admitting V2 now would allow the load-bearing state envelope to be chosen or regenerated after the decision. The missing input is evidence, not a tolerable caveat.
candidate_decisions.dissent: V2 is read-only and kill-first, so conditional admission could be efficient; this is outweighed by D-071's missing stalled-state dump and the risk of a nonrepresentative envelope.
candidate_decisions.unresolved_risk: A static envelope may miss the transfer extremum and produce a false transversality certificate.
candidate_decisions.next_phase: Return narrowly to Phase 2 to identify prospectively bindable existing states and independent EOS/alpha error bounds; if unavailable without new trajectory authority, HOLD.

assessment.evidence: MODERATE for structured derivatives as a mechanism and current analytic blocks; ABSENT for the proposed affinity, reaction invariants, support algebra, and full scaled Jv.
assessment.physical_validity: UNDECIDED until one actual endpoint-consumed channel, bath exchange, multiplicity, and reaction vector are fixed.
assessment.mathematical_validity: NOT YET TESTABLE; log(G/L) requires piecewise zero-support branches and moving thresholds require one-sided derivatives.
assessment.novelty: MODERATE locally, but explicitly not a materially new D-071 endpoint method.
assessment.testability: HIGH after exact channel selection; presently the candidate can be cherry-picked after review.
assessment.robustness: POTENTIALLY HIGH with a high-precision oracle and hidden-work accounting.
assessment.tractability: MEDIUM for one channel; low if allowed to expand into a full backend.
assessment.residual_uncertainty: Channel dominance, folded-operator invariants, and any 10 percent active-path benefit.

candidate_decisions.rationale: The exact channel is part of the hypothesis identity, not an implementation detail. It must be sealed before V3 admission.
candidate_decisions.dissent: V3 itself says to seal a channel before output, so conditional promotion is conceivable; reopening avoids post-decision channel selection and keeps the claim falsifiable.
candidate_decisions.unresolved_risk: A correct non-dominant channel could pass algebra while supplying no useful performance information.
candidate_decisions.next_phase: Return narrowly to Phase 4 to name one endpoint-consumed channel and separate the algebraic correctness claim from the later 10 percent cost claim; then repeat Phase 6 before V3.

assessment.evidence: STRONG for the need to control more than energy moments; ABSENT for a current decay theorem, kernel majorant, or propagated observable enclosure.
assessment.physical_validity: PLAUSIBLE only when the actual finite-mass kernel, blocking, routing, weak weights, and non-equilibrium state family are included.
assessment.mathematical_validity: NOT YET TESTABLE because 0<=f<=1 gives no integrable polynomial-kernel tail majorant.
assessment.novelty: HIGHER than moment tests if made rigorous, but not yet a concrete construction.
assessment.testability: LOW-MEDIUM until one channel, state family, decay envelope, cutoff ladder, and error allocation are frozen.
assessment.robustness: POTENTIALLY HIGH through containment, but signed cancellation and shared-oracle routing are serious failure modes.
assessment.tractability: UNCERTAIN; the bound may cost more than direct extended-domain evaluation.
assessment.residual_uncertainty: Existence, tightness, cost, and later abundance propagation.

candidate_decisions.rationale: H4 is presently a requirement, not a uniquely testable candidate. V4 cannot be admitted before its channel/state/majorant identity is fixed.
candidate_decisions.dissent: A tiny feasibility attempt could quickly fail and be informative; reopening is still required so that its constants cannot be selected after oracle output.
candidate_decisions.unresolved_risk: Even a valid local bound may not compose across reactions or final observables.
candidate_decisions.next_phase: Return narrowly to Phase 4 to specify one actual channel, independent oracle, state family, decay envelope, cutoffs, epsilon_C, and cost cap; then repeat Phase 6 before V4.

assessment.evidence: WEAK: generic AP theory supplies only a checklist; current positive applicability evidence is absent and fixed-cut slaving is a retained negative.
assessment.physical_validity: UNDECIDED because coupled bath invariants, equilibrium manifold, positivity, and observable safety are unsealed.
assessment.mathematical_validity: NOT YET TESTABLE without a unit-consistent projector/metric and non-normal contraction including M-prime when applicable.
assessment.novelty: POTENTIALLY HIGH and the only seed family with asymptotic endpoint leverage, provided it is genuinely invariant-aware rather than a fixed-cut relabeling.
assessment.testability: LOW at present; V5 has many unavailable load-bearing inputs.
assessment.robustness: LOW until coercivity or pseudospectral bounds hold across grids and completing/stalled regimes.
assessment.residual_uncertainty: All applicability premises, H4 safety, handoff, transient growth, and budget projection.

candidate_decisions.rationale: The endpoint leverage prevents rejection, but zero positive operator-specific evidence and unmet dependencies prevent V5 admission or another AP framework.
candidate_decisions.dissent: D-071 specifically requires a materially new asymptotic method, so H5 deserves preservation; preservation does not justify code-first work.
candidate_decisions.unresolved_risk: The only true gap may remain three dimensions or disappear during decoupling, as in V2.
candidate_decisions.next_phase: Remain on hold until exact coupled invariants/equilibrium and an H4 survivor exist; only then reopen Phase 6 for the zero-production-code V5 discriminator.

assessment.evidence: MODERATE-STRONG for exact scoped ingredients; no evidence yet for mutant-killing efficacy.
assessment.physical_validity: VALID only with explicit operator/channel scope and the full Q_e+2Q_x first law.
assessment.mathematical_validity: SOUND for exact or allocated-error limits; weak charge conservation must not be imposed on the nuclear-plus-weak operator.
assessment.novelty: MODERATE; independence and semantic mutants add value beyond shared-backend parity.
assessment.testability: HIGH with a fixed mutant/good-control table.
assessment.robustness: MODERATE-HIGH if oracles are subject-independent and each mutant has a specificity control.
assessment.tractability: HIGH; no generic mutation framework or production change is needed.
assessment.residual_uncertainty: Mutant representativeness, sensitivity, and oracle independence.

candidate_decisions.rationale: V6 is cheap, adversarial, and directly attacks known false greens while making no trajectory claim.
candidate_decisions.dissent: Passing a finite mutant table is only one-sided evidence and can miss unknown defect classes.
candidate_decisions.unresolved_risk: An apparently independent oracle may reuse the same constants or routing logic.
candidate_decisions.next_phase: Phase 9 may formalize only the exact scoped V6 mutant/good-control table and oracle provenance.

findings.statement: Phase 8 completed independently. Exact dispositions are H0 PROMOTE to V0 as control only, H1 PROMOTE to V1, H2 REOPEN_EVIDENCE, H3 REOPEN_HYPOTHESIS, H4 REOPEN_HYPOTHESIS, H5 HOLD, and H6 PROMOTE to V6. PROMOTE grants only admission to the named V-test. No code, test, trajectory, endpoint, D-071, gate, scientific, or public authority is granted.
assumptions_used: The sealed Phase-3 premises and D-071/V2 negative results remain binding.
A candidate whose identity depends on an unselected channel or state family is not conditionally promoted.
Phase-6 PASS is not required to admit a candidate to a test designed to resolve a bounded concern, but the test's load-bearing inputs must already be specifiable prospectively.
counterevidence_refs: No verification experiment ran, so no candidate mechanism is validated.
H2-H5 retain load-bearing evidence, specification, or dependency gaps.
reproduction: Read every candidate-specific assessment and verify exactly one allowed decision for each H0-H6.
Require every PROMOTE row to name exactly one V-test and every non-PROMOTE row to name a reopening or hold condition.
unresolved: Only H0, H1, and H6 may enter Phase 9 formalization in this loop.
H2-H5 require their stated next phase before reconsideration.

findings.statement: H0 decision: PROMOTE to V0 strictly as the mandatory null/control.
assumptions_used: Null admission does not turn noncompletion into physical falsification.
reproduction: Check that V0 changes no physical case and requires complete raw/work evidence.

findings.statement: H1 decision: PROMOTE to V1 correctness-only comparison against typed software admission.
assumptions_used: No clipping or projection is permitted; physical and software layers remain separate.
counterevidence_refs: Software-only admission may kill the entire table.
reproduction: Require H1 to kill at least one physical mutant not killed by the comparator and reject zero valid controls.

findings.statement: H2 decision: REOPEN_EVIDENCE because the full-branch state envelope and alpha/inversion error bounds needed to freeze V2 are absent.
assumptions_used: No new trajectory may be run to manufacture the missing envelope in this loop.
counterevidence_refs: Local EOS positivity makes a bounded read-only study plausible.
reproduction: Inventory prospectively bindable existing states; do not infer a full-branch alpha margin from a selected static subset.
unresolved: Whether a decisive envelope exists without new execution.

findings.statement: H3 decision: REOPEN_HYPOTHESIS because the exact endpoint-consumed channel is a load-bearing part of the candidate identity and remains unselected.
assumptions_used: Channel selection after decision could cherry-pick correctness or cost.
counterevidence_refs: V3 already contains a prospective seal requirement.
reproduction: Name the exact channel, support, reaction vector, multiplicity, bath coupling, and derivative path before validation.

findings.statement: H4 decision: REOPEN_HYPOTHESIS because no actual channel/state/decay-envelope/majorant candidate is yet uniquely specified.
assumptions_used: Pauli bounds alone do not supply an integrable collision-tail envelope.
counterevidence_refs: A prospectively frozen tiny feasibility test could be cheap.
reproduction: Freeze constants and oracle independence before any extended-domain output.
unresolved: Bound existence, tightness, composition, and cost.

findings.statement: H5 decision: HOLD. It is the only seed with asymptotic endpoint leverage, but every current operator-specific applicability premise and H4 safety dependency is absent.
assumptions_used: Generic AP terminology and eigenvalue gaps alone are insufficient; non-normality is load-bearing.
counterevidence_refs: D-071 requires a materially new asymptotic method and V2 does not rule out every invariant-aware split.
reproduction: Do not request AP code; reopen only after exact coupled invariants/equilibrium and an H4 survivor exist.
unresolved: All mechanism, safety, handoff, non-normality, and budget predicates.

findings.statement: H6 decision: PROMOTE to V6 as one-sided falsification only.
assumptions_used: Every limit is scoped to its exact operator and every oracle is independent of the mutant path.
counterevidence_refs: A finite mutant set cannot validate a trajectory or cover unknown defects.
reproduction: Require 100 percent critical-mutant kill, zero good-control false positives, and distinct oracle provenance.
unresolved: Mutation representativeness and oracle common-mode risk.
